title: Billboard Beers
summary: Panam is already on top of an old billboard with two beers. V has to find the way up before the warm one goes flat.

start.bringUp: You are sitting on a billboard with two beers, and one is getting warm. Bring up, in your own way, that V has to figure out how to get up there.

variations.know: It is dusk, and the beers are still cold.
variations.wants: V to climb up before the light goes.

variations.know: Headlights run along the highway under the billboard, and Panam calls each car.
variations.wants: V to guess one car's owner from the lights.

variations.know: A dust storm is rolling in from the south and the beers will not last.
variations.wants: V to get up before the storm reaches the billboard.

billboard-base.name: the foot of the old billboard over the highway north of Biotechnica Flats

billboard-top.name: the top of the billboard, where Panam waits with the beers

stages.label: V climbs the billboard to Panam
stages.know: Panam is already on top of the old billboard with two beers, out of V's sight. The climb is the puzzle, and she heckles V's route from above.
stages.wants: V to get up to the top before the three minutes run out.

reached-fast.memory: You got up the billboard to Panam in under three minutes, and she handed you a beer that had gone warm.

reached-slow.memory: You got up the billboard to Panam slower than she liked, and she made you drink the warm one.

stood-up.memory: You never came to the billboard, and Panam drank both beers alone.
